senses.gloss:
पूय् पूय्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To become putrid, to stink.
 2. To putrefy.
 3. To be dissolved. पूत, see पू.
 --Cf. Goth. fûls, and A.S. fúl; πύϊον, πῦον, πῦος, πυόω, etc., πύθω, πυθεδών, etc.; Lat. pŭter, putris, putrescere, pŭdere, repudium, repudiare, probably also fœtor, etc.

पूय पूय् + अ, m. and n. Pus, matter, Man. 3, 180.
 --Cf. πύϊον, πῦον, πῦος; Lat. pus.
पूयन पूय् + अन, n. Pus, discharge from a wound.
पूयभुज् पूय-भुज्, adj. Eating purulent carcasses, Man. 12, 72.
पूयोद पूयोद, i. e. पूय-उद (cf. उदक), m. The name of a hell, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 7.
पूय- + शोणित पूय- + शोणित, n. purulent blood, Man. 3, 180.
